1.title: Florida picks nominees for governor, and other takeaways from US primaries
1.summary: Highlights from a day of voting in the US - including triumph in Alaska for one Dan Sullivan over another Dan Sullivan.

2.title: Inside the Data Center Capital of the World
2.summary: Cecilia Kang, who covers technology and regulatory policy for The New York Times, traveled to the “data center capital of the world” to see how the A.I. boom is affecting Loudoun County, Va.

3.title: Mary Peltola and Dan Sullivan Advance in Key Alaska Senate Contest
3.summary: Both parties see Alaska as key to winning the Senate. The state’s nonpartisan primary put Mary Peltola, a Democratic former congresswoman, on the same ballot as Dan Sullivan, the incumbent Republican she hopes to unseat. Both advanced to the general election.

4.title: Retail giant Target receives $1bn boost from tariff refunds
4.summary: The US chain said it received a $994 million pre-tax reimbursement, which resulted in its second quarter operating income rising to $2.6bn.

5.title: Israel Opens Criminal Investigation Into Killings of Hind Rajab and Gaza Medical Workers
5.summary: Two high-profile cases that had spurred international condemnation of the country’s conduct in Gaza were transferred to the military police. Such investigations have rarely led to convictions.

6.title: South Korea shortens war games with US, citing Washington request
6.summary: It comes after Trump announced plans to curtail joint military exercises with South Korea, citing a "very good" relationship with North Korea's Kim Jong Un.
